name: How do you choose between tile and shower wall panels?

mainEntity.name: Which is better for a walk-in shower remodel: custom tile walls or large shower wall panels?
mainEntity.text: Which is better for a walk-in shower remodel: custom tile walls or large shower wall panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between tile and shower wall panels depends on the balance between design, maintenance, budget, and installation time. Tile is usually preferred for a custom luxury look because it offers more texture, pattern, color, and detail options. It also allows for precise coordination with the rest of the bathroom. However, tile takes more labor to install and requires careful grout maintenance over time. Shower wall panels can be a strong choice when the homeowner wants a fast, clean, low-maintenance solution with fewer seams. They are often easier to wipe down and can reduce installation complexity. The downside is that some panel systems feel more standardized and may not deliver the same visual depth as a tile build. In high-end remodels, the decision often comes down to whether the goal is a statement shower or a streamlined, practical one. The contractor should explain both the aesthetic and maintenance tradeoffs before the materials are selected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile offers more design flexibility, while shower wall panels are usually faster to install and easier to clean. Tile can create a more custom luxury look, but it requires more labor and maintenance. Wall panels are simpler, but the finished style may feel less bespoke depending on the product and layout.
